verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents its own automation surfaces. The Editor API supports programmatic scene manipulation and asset management. The official MCP server lets an AI agent modify project data in an open Editor session. Through these, an agent or script can plausibly apply changes across many entities or assets, but no explicit bulk or batch operation is documented. missing for 10: an explicit documented multi-item/batch operation capability (e.g. multi-select bulk edits or batch API/MCP tools), any limits or transactional semantics for bulk changes, and hands-on corroboration of bulk edits via MCP or the Editor API.
